title: LBNL Building 59 NERSC Facility Upgrade II
scope: Complete 311-page visual review with source-bounded BAS network riser, named panel/controller, CWGP VFD point mappings, BACnet context, ACHE bypass valve feedback/position, controller I/O contexts and explicit non-inference limits.
reading_notes: J601 is an unusually strong BAS network riser with multiple protocols, controller/panel labels and communications paths.
J604/J605 and J608/J610 are high-value vector control drawings with VFD point mapping, valve feedback/position and controller I/O functions.
J002 control-panel schedule is visually reviewed but conservatively kept out of text-row matrix claims where native table text is unavailable.
verification_semantics: Every retained text row/assertion is rechecked against independent MuPDF and Poppler evidence; visual-only facts are explicitly flagged. No physical takeoff is inferred.

requirement_audit.finding: Cover title identifies LBNL Building 59 NERSC Facility Upgrade II.
All 311 pages are visually reviewed; J002/J601/J604/J605/J608–J613 have explicit retained context.
No global scale or plan-derived physical quantity is asserted.
Published CWGP-1 VFD source rows and visual control-panel schedule entries are retained without installation inference.
VFD enable/speed/feedback/kW/HOA/fault source rows are coordinate-bounded.
Six literal CWGP-1 VFD point mappings are retained with source-only ownership scope.
J601 publishes a Building Automation Network Riser with BACnet/IP, BACnet/MS/TP, CMnet, Modbus and named panels/controllers.
Pump VFD controls, ACHE bypass modulating-valve feedback/position and controller wiring/IO diagrams are retained.
Pump suction/discharge pressure, VFD status/commands, filter/PDE/PDT status, mixed-water temperature and fan status are published contexts.
Physical-count, final wiring, controller ownership and unextractable visual schedule limitations are explicit.
Every page has a Poppler full-page review render.
All retained text rows/assertions are rechecked against MuPDF and Poppler.
